notes.title: Finally No Bugfix but small improvement :0
notes.content:
1.-Now a counter appears every time a round is won in preggo or nothing.
2.-Added in the menu a log of unlocked extras by the player.
3.-Now in the main menu will appear the your highscore on preggo or nothing.

notes.title: Even More bug fixes!
notes.content:
1.- fixed another bug with the spanker where the dealer would throw away all your items.
2.- fixed another bug when using the spanker with the shibari you would take 4 items from the dealer

sorry for the bugs ;c

notes.title: More bug fixes ;0
notes.content:
1.- Sometimes the mask did not change the polarity of the card (joker -> to heart or heart -> joker) now it works correctly.
2.- If the dealer used the spanker against you and you only had one item, the game would go into an infinite loop and crash. This problem has been fixed in version 1.0.3.
3.- The current version of the game can be seen in the options menu in the lower left corner.

Thanks to everyone who helped me and those who told me how to cause bugs so I can fix them faster. and to everyone who had problems I'm sorry :c I will work until the game is problem free <3
